A singing comedian (Dean Martin) flops on his own, then soars with a sidekick (Jerry Lewis) but insists on hogging the show.
programme.title: The Stooge

programme.desc: After Herbert (Jerry Lewis) loses his lover, he gives up women for good. To get over them, he takes a maintenance position at boarding house, but to his surprise, the building caters specifically to single ladies.
programme.title: The Ladies' Man

programme.desc: A mute bellboy (Jerry Lewis) working at the luxurious Fontainebleau Hotel in Miami Beach constantly causes problems with his clumsy mistakes.
programme.title: The Bellboy

programme.desc: A bachelor (Jerry Lewis) agrees to baby-sit for a Hollywood star (Marilyn Maxwell), who turns out to have triplets.
programme.title: Rock-a-Bye Baby

programme.desc: Goofy professor Kelp's potion turns him into Buddy Love, a lounge singer at ease with a coed and a crowd.
programme.title: The Nutty Professor

programme.desc: During the Civil War, reports of a sea monster attacking ships alarm the Navy. An investigation finds the monster is a submarine, the "Nautilus," commanded by vengeance-seeking Capt. Nemo (Allen Holubar), who was once an Indian prince.
programme.title: 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea

programme.desc: A Broadway producer (Zero Mostel) and his accountant (Gene Wilder) back a sure-fire flop: "Springtime for Hitler."
programme.title: The Producers

programme.desc: Married lawyers (Spencer Tracy, Katharine Hepburn) clash in and out of court over a woman's (Judy Holliday) right to shoot her husband and his lover.
programme.title: Adam's Rib

programme.desc: Two sailors (Frank Sinatra, Gene Kelly) on leave in Hollywood help an actress (Kathryn Grayson) get her big break.
programme.title: Anchors Aweigh

programme.desc: Supercomputer HAL 9000 guides astronauts (Keir Dullea, Gary Lockwood, William Sylvester) on a trip to find the origins of humans.
programme.title: 2001: A Space Odyssey

programme.desc: S01 E24 — The Stranger As Ben prepares to run for governor, Joe must come to his rescue when a disabled police officer from New Orleans comes to arrest Ben on a 20-year-old murder charge.
programme.title: Bonanza

programme.desc: Controversial British officer T.E. Lawrence (Peter O'Toole) learns the culture of Arabs (Alec Guinness, Anthony Quinn) and unites their tribes against the Turks.
programme.title: Lawrence of Arabia

programme.desc: Shakespeare's king of England (Kenneth Branagh) attacks France and declares his love for the French king's daughter.
programme.title: Henry V

programme.desc: British pirate William Kidd captures Adm. Blaine's treasure ship and hides the bounty in a cave. Three years later, Kidd, posing as a sea captain, offers his services to the king as an escort ship.
programme.title: Captain Kidd

programme.desc: A snooty socialite (Katharine Hepburn) fights with her ex-husband (Cary Grant) and flirts with a reporter (James Stewart).
programme.title: The Philadelphia Story

programme.desc: A recluse mountain man becomes the unwilling object of a long vendetta by Indians, and proves to be a match for their warriors.
programme.title: Jeremiah Johnson

programme.desc: Lovers quarrel around surfers, Don Rickles, Buster Keaton, Von Zipper's biker gang.
programme.title: Beach Blanket Bingo

programme.desc: A Quaker (Gail Russell) and her family reform a wounded outlaw (John Wayne) who has a killer on his trail.
programme.title: Angel and the Badman

programme.desc: Two broke jazzmen (Bing Crosby, Bob Hope) hop a southbound ship and save a hypnotized heiress (Dorothy Lamour) from her sinister aunt.
programme.title: Road to Rio

programme.desc: A cartoonist (Dean Martin) turns his babbling roommate's (Jerry Lewis) bizarre dreams into a hit comic strip read by spies.
programme.title: Artists and Models

programme.desc: A rancher's (John Wayne) wife (Maureen O'Hara) summons him home to hunt down the outlaw (Richard Boone) and gang who kidnapped his grandson.
programme.title: Big Jake

programme.desc: A lusty Greek peasant (Anthony Quinn) shows a British writer (Alan Bates) how to live and run a lignite mine.
programme.title: Zorba the Greek

programme.desc: An outlaw (Henry Fonda) working for a railroad magnate fights a stranger (Charles Bronson) for a New Orleans widow's (Claudia Cardinale) land.
programme.title: Once Upon a Time in the West

programme.desc: Texas wildcatters (Clark Gable, Spencer Tracy) hit oil together, then fight after one marries the other's sweetheart (Claudette Colbert).
programme.title: Boom Town

programme.desc: A bounty hunter (Glenn Ford) faces his son's killers with help from the son (Michael Burns) of an outlaw he has killed.
programme.title: Santee

programme.title: Stoney Burke

programme.title: Bye Bye Birdie

programme.title: Bachelor in Paradise

programme.title: Cabin in the Sky
